name: NCP1117ST33T3G 3.3V 1A LDO SOT-223 C26537
label: NCP1117ST33T3G
source: JLCPCB parts library page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C26537 read 2026-11-10 (onsemi NCP1117ST33T3G, SOT-223, library type Extended) ; datasheet: https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/ncp1117-d.pdf (onsemi NCP1117/D, August 2021 - Rev. 31, read 2026-11-10) ; vout.voltage: ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS table, printed page 3, 'Output Voltage, Fixed Output Devices', 3.3 V line, Vin = 4.75 V to 10 V and Iout = 0 mA to 800 mA over the operating ambient range (note 4): min 3.235 V, max 3.365 V ; dropout: the same table, page 3, 'Dropout Voltage (Measured at Vout - 100 mV)', Iout = 800 mA: max 1.20 V (typ 1.07 V) ; max_current and max_power: see notes ; temp_min, temp_max: MAXIMUM RATINGS, page 2, 'Operating Ambient Temperature Range', NCP1117: 0 to +125 C (the NCP1117 line of the table, which the ordering table on page 12 lists the ST33T3G under)
notes: onsemi. Fixed 3.3 V, SOT-223, tab joined to pin 2 (page 1). Pins: 1 = Adjust/Ground, 2 = Output, 3 = Input (page 1), the LinearRegulator pin table of std. Columns: vout.voltage is the datasheet's worst case over line, load and temperature (3.3 V -1.97% / +1.97%), not the 25 C line (3.267 V to 3.333 V at Vin = 5.3 V, 10 mA). dropout is the maximum at 800 mA (1.10 V at 100 mA, 1.15 V at 500 mA); the datasheet states no dropout above 800 mA. max_current is 0.8 A, the highest current at which the datasheet states the output voltage and the dropout: the datasheet's other figures are 'Output Current in Excess of 1.0 A' (page 1, features), the output current limit of 1000 mA minimum, 1500 typical and 2200 maximum (page 3, Vin - Vout = 5.0 V, 25 C) and note 3 (page 2: the output current must not exceed 1.0 A with Vin above 12 V); none of them is a continuous rating, and JLCPCB lists 1 A. max_power is DERIVED, not a datasheet figure: the datasheet gives the power dissipation as 'Internally Limited' (page 2) with PD = (TJ(max) - TA) / RthJA, RthJA = 160 C/W for the SOT-223 on a minimum size pad and TJ = 150 C at most (page 2): (150 - 25) / 160 = 0.78 W at an ambient of 25 C. It is not derated for a hotter board (0.16 W at 125 C ambient) or improved for more copper (the datasheet's figure 21 gives the copper area). Quiescent current is 6.0 mA typical and 10 mA maximum for the 3.3 V version at Vin = 15 V (page 4, 'Quiescent Current', IQ): the catalog has no column for it, so a board states it (.quiescent_current &= 0mA..10mA). Not read: the package height (the drawing is a picture).
